investigator.method: Bounded Level 1 PASSIVE_STATIC investigation per BOTM-LONDON-SECOND-LIVE-TRANCHE-01: one unauthenticated GET to the venue's official_website (WebFetch/curl fallback), with at most one additional same-origin GET when official_programme_url was directly supplied as a candidate field. No browser, authentication, CAPTCHA bypass, or retry loop.

venue_reference: Donmar Warehouse — Earlham Street, WC2H 9LX, London

identity.notes: og:site_name, og:url, and <title> all match the venue name and official domain exactly; no cross-domain redirect occurred. The candidate-supplied official_programme_url (/whats-on) is linked directly from the fetched homepage nav.

site_classification.platform: Server-rendered custom site (built by Supercool Design per the page's own JSON-LD); homepage includes server-rendered production listings and JSON-LD blocks.

probe_history.reason: A single unauthenticated GET to the official homepage returned server-rendered current-production listings (with playwright/author credits and 'Book now' ticketing links) that directly and unambiguously identify the venue's core programme as theatrical plays, conclusively answering the music-relevance question without further escalation.

reasons: The fetched homepage's own server-rendered content lists current productions 'A Month in the Country' (by Brian Friel, after Ivan Turgenev) and 'Ilford Boy' (by Danny Lee Wynter), each with a playwright credit, synopsis, and 'Book now'/'More info' ticketing links to /events/<slug> pages — this is real, retained evidence of a theatrical (play) programme, not a music programme.

The retained keyword scan of the fetched body shows 82 occurrences of 'production' and 12 of 'play' against zero occurrences of 'concert', 'gig', 'jazz', 'live music', or 'theatre' as a self-descriptor — consistent with a producing theatre staging scripted plays, failing BeatMapped's venue-level music gate.

evidence.description: Verbatim, byte-faithful <head> excerpt: <title> and og tags, confirming venue identity.
evidence.method: curl -sS -L; descriptive User-Agent; single unauthenticated GET; redirects followed; no retry

evidence.description: Verbatim, byte-faithful excerpts of the two currently-featured production cards on the homepage, each naming a play, its author, a synopsis, and ticketing links — real evidence of a theatrical programme.
